```{r, loading data}

data <- read_csv(
  "D:/Downloads/RVF KAP Survey_Wajir_Excel cleaned data.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "Windows-1252")
)
```


```{r, data cleaning and validation}
df1 <- data %>%
  #drop meta data/columns
  select(-matches("^meta/|^_|instanceID")) %>%

  #drop redundant columns
  select(-matches("^livestock_owned/|^learn_source/|^transmit_animals/|
                   ^affected_animals/|^transmit_humans/|
                   ^signs_and_symptoms_animals/|^signs_and_symptoms_humans/")) %>%

  #rename the columns
  rename(
    consent                  = 1, 
    interview_date           = `Date of Interview`,
    interviewer_name         = `Name of Interviewer`,
    subcounty                = `Sub-county`,
    ward                     = `Ward`,
    location                 = `Location`,
    village                  = `Village`,
    keeps_livestock          = `Do you keep livestock?`,
    respondent_type          = `Respondent`,
    respondent_other         = `Others...10`,
    role                     = `What is your capacity/role?`,
    role_other               = `Others...12`,
    gender                   = `What is your gender?`,
    age_group                = `Which of the following best describes your age group?`,
    education_level          = `What is the highest education level you completed?`,
    hh_size                  = `Number of people in the household?`,
    hh_adults                = `Adult`,
    hh_children              = `Children`,
    monthly_income_ksh       = `Average Monthly income in Ksh`,
    farming_system           = `What is your farming system?`,
    farming_system_other     = `Others...21`,
    livestock_types          = `Type of livestock owned (select all that apply)`,
    livestock_other          = `Others...29`,
    gps_raw                  = `Household GPS Coordinates`,
    gps_latitude             = `demographics/_gps_latitude`,
    gps_longitude            = `demographics/_gps_longitude`,
    gps_altitude             = `demographics/_gps_altitude`,
    gps_precision            = `demographics/_gps_precision`,
    heard_of_rvf             = `Have you ever heard about Rift Valley Fever (RVF)?`,
    rvf_affects_humans       = `Can RVF affect humans?`,
    rvf_learn_source         = `How/where did you learn about RVF?`,
    learn_source_other       = `Others (Specify)...51`,
    rvf_transmit_animals     = `How is RVF transmitted to animals?`,
    transmit_animals_other   = `Others (Specify)...60`,
    rvf_affected_animals     = `What animals can get RVF?`,
    rvf_vaccine_available    = `Is vaccination against RVF available for livestock?`,
    rvf_worry_season         = `Which season of the year do you get particularly worried about RVF?`,
    rvf_transmit_humans      = `How is RVF transmitted to humans? (Select all that apply)`,
    transmit_humans_other    = `Others (Specify)...77`,
    rvf_signs_animals        = `What are common signs or symptoms of RVF in animals? (Select all that apply)`,
    signs_animals_other      = `Others (Specify)...89`,
    rvf_signs_humans         = `What are common signs or symptoms of RVF in humans? (Select all that apply)`,
    signs_humans_other       = `Others (Specify)...101`,
    rvf_is_dangerous         = `Do you agree RVF is a dangerous disease?`,
    herd_had_rvf             = `Has your herd ever experienced RVF infection?`,
    hh_member_had_rvf        = `Were any of your household members affected by RVF previously?`,
    self_at_risk             = `Are you at risk of RVF infection?`,
    community_concern        = `How concerned are you about RVF infection in humans in your community?`,
    rvf_spread_preventable   = `Do you believe the spread of RVF from animals to humans can be prevented?`,
    vaccine_effectiveness    = `How effective do you think vaccination of animals is in preventing RVF?`,
    vaccinates_livestock     = `Do you vaccinate your livestock against RVF?`,
    mosquito_control_freq    = `How often do you use mosquito control methods around livestock?`,
    avoids_sick_animals      = `Do you avoid slaughtering or handling sick or dead animals?`,
    avoids_abortus           = `Do you avoid touching an abortus foetus?`,
    uses_protective_gear     = `Do you use protective clothing/gear (e.g., gloves) when handling animals, especially during birthing or slaughtering?`,
    cooks_meat_thoroughly    = `Do you thoroughly cook meat before consuming?`,
    reports_to_authorities   = `In the event of abortions or sudden deaths in your livestock, do you report to veterinary or public health authorities?`
  )
```


```{r, null percentage}
null_pct <- data.frame(
  column = names(df1),
  pct_missing = round(colMeans(is.na(df1)) * 100, 1)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

print(null_pct)

```

```{r, visual for nulls}
# Calculate missingness
null_pct <- data.frame(
  column     = names(df1),
  pct_missing = round(colMeans(is.na(df1)) * 100, 1)
) %>%
  filter(pct_missing > 0) %>% 
  arrange(pct_missing) %>%
  mutate(column = factor(column, levels = column))  

# Plot
ggplot(null_pct, aes(x = pct_missing, y = column)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E86AB", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(pct_missing, "%")),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2, color = "grey30"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(null_pct$pct_missing) * 1.15),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Missing Data by Column",
    subtitle = paste0("df1  |  ", nrow(df1), " rows  ·  Showing ", nrow(null_pct), " columns with missing values"),
    x        = "% Missing",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```


```{r, checking dtypes}
df2 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(

    # Factors: 
    consent           = factor(consent),
    subcounty         = factor(subcounty),
    ward              = factor(ward),
    location          = factor(location),
    village           = factor(village),
    interviewer_name  = factor(interviewer_name),
    respondent_type   = factor(respondent_type),
    role              = factor(role),
    gender            = factor(gender),
    farming_system    = factor(farming_system),
    rvf_worry_season  = factor(rvf_worry_season),

    # Binary
    keeps_livestock      = factor(keeps_livestock,   levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    heard_of_rvf         = factor(heard_of_rvf,      levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    rvf_affects_humans   = factor(rvf_affects_humans, levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    herd_had_rvf         = factor(herd_had_rvf,      levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    hh_member_had_rvf    = factor(hh_member_had_rvf, levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    self_at_risk         = factor(self_at_risk,      levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    rvf_spread_preventable = factor(rvf_spread_preventable,
                              levels = c("Yes", "No", "Don't know")),
    rvf_vaccine_available  = factor(rvf_vaccine_available,
                              levels = c("Yes", "No", "Don't know")),

    #ordinal
    age_group = factor(age_group,
                  levels = c("18–24", "25–34", "35–44", "45–54", "55 and above"),
                  ordered = TRUE),

    education_level = factor(education_level,
                  levels = c("No formal education", "Primary",
                             "Secondary", "Tertiary/College", "University"),
                  ordered = TRUE),

    monthly_income_ksh = factor(monthly_income_ksh,
                  levels = c("Below 500", "500 - 4,999", "5,000 - 19,999",
                             "20,000 - 49,999", "50,000 and above"),
                  ordered = TRUE),

    rvf_is_dangerous = factor(rvf_is_dangerous,
                  levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral",
                             "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
                  ordered = TRUE),

    community_concern = factor(community_concern,
                  levels = c("Not concerned", "Somewhat concerned",
                             "Very concerned", "Extremely concerned",
                             "I don't know"),
                  ordered = FALSE),  

    vaccine_effectiveness = factor(vaccine_effectiveness,
                  levels = c("Not effective", "Somewhat effective",
                             "Very effective", "Extremely effective",
                             "I don't know"),
                  ordered = FALSE),

    #frequency
    across(c(mosquito_control_freq, avoids_sick_animals, avoids_abortus,
             uses_protective_gear, cooks_meat_thoroughly),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c("Never", "Sometimes", "Often", "Always"),
                    ordered = TRUE)),

    vaccinates_livestock = factor(vaccinates_livestock,
                  levels = c("No", "Yes, sometimes", "Yes, regularly",
                             "I don't know about vaccination")),

    reports_to_authorities = factor(reports_to_authorities,
                  levels = c("Never", "Sometimes", "Often", "Always",
                             "I'm not aware of reporting procedures")),

   #drop the nulls
    across(where(~ is.logical(.x) && all(is.na(.x))), ~ NULL)
  )

```

```{r, transmission binary indicators}

# Animal transmission binary indicators 
for (item in transmit_animal_items) {
  col_name <- paste0("anim_", str_replace_all(item, " ", "_"))
  df2[[col_name]] <- as.integer(str_detect(df2$rvf_transmit_animals, fixed(item)))
}

# Human transmission binary
for (item in transmit_human_items) {
  col_name <- paste0("hum_", str_replace_all(item, " ", "_"))
  df2[[col_name]] <- as.integer(str_detect(df2$rvf_transmit_humans, fixed(item)))
}

```

```{r}
df2 %>% select(starts_with("anim_"), starts_with("hum_")) %>% glimpse()
```

```{r, information sources}
learn_sources <- c("Health professional", "Veterinary professional",
```

```{r, attitudes}

attitude_vars <- c("rvf_is_dangerous", "community_concern",
                   "vaccine_effectiveness", "rvf_spread_preventable", "self_at_risk")

attitude_labels <- c(
  rvf_is_dangerous       = "RVF is dangerous",
  community_concern      = "Concern level in community",
  vaccine_effectiveness  = "Vaccine effectiveness belief",
  rvf_spread_preventable = "Spread can be prevented",
  self_at_risk           = "Perceives self at risk"
)

plots_attitude <- lapply(attitude_vars, function(var) {
  df2 %>%
    count(.data[[var]]) %>%
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(.data[[var]], pct), y = pct)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#E07A5F", width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct,1),"%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 110)) +
    labs(title = attitude_labels[[var]], x = NULL, y = "%") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
})

wrap_plots(plots_attitude, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Attitudes toward RVF",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)))

```

##Tables for thesis

```{r,Table 1. Socio-demographic Characteristics of Respondents}
df2 %>%
  select(gender, age_group, education_level, monthly_income_ksh,
         farming_system, respondent_type, role,
         hh_size, hh_adults, hh_children) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      gender             ~ "Gender",
      age_group          ~ "Age Group",
      education_level    ~ "Education Level",
      monthly_income_ksh ~ "Monthly Income (Ksh)",
      farming_system     ~ "Farming System",
      respondent_type    ~ "Respondent Type",
      role               ~ "Role/Capacity",
      hh_size            ~ "Household Size",
      hh_adults          ~ "Number of Adults",
      hh_children        ~ "Number of Children"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ 1,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    ),
    missing      = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  italicize_levels() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  modify_caption(
    "**Table 1. Socio-demographic Characteristics of Respondents (N = {N})**"
  ) %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "n (%); Mean (SD)"
  )

```

```{r, Table 2. Knowledge about Rift Valley Fever}
df2 %>%
  select(heard_of_rvf, rvf_affects_humans, rvf_vaccine_available,
         rvf_worry_season, rvf_affected_animals) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      heard_of_rvf          ~ "Ever heard of Rift Valley Fever",
      rvf_affects_humans    ~ "Knows RVF can affect humans",
      rvf_vaccine_available ~ "Aware that RVF vaccine exists for livestock",
      rvf_worry_season      ~ "Season of concern for RVF",
      rvf_affected_animals  ~ "Animals known to be affected by RVF"
    ),
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    digits    = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),
    missing   = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  italicize_levels() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 2. Knowledge about Rift Valley Fever (N = {N})**") %>%
  modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~ "n (%)")

```



```{r,Table 3. Knowledge of Rift Valley Fever Transmission Routes}
table3 <- df2 %>%

  # Select variables
  select(starts_with("anim_"), starts_with("hum_")) %>%

  # Create summary table
  tbl_summary(

    type = all_categorical() ~ "categorical",

    label = list(

      # Animal transmission
      anim_Mosquito_bites ~
        "Mosquito bites",

      anim_Contact_with_abortus_in_pasture ~
        "Contact with abortus in pasture",

      anim_Contact_with_infected_animals ~
        "Contact with infected animals",

      anim_Drinking_water_contaminated_by_infected_animals ~
        "Drinking contaminated water",

      anim_Contact_with_wildlife ~
        "Contact with wildlife",

      anim_Direct_contact_with_discharge_from_infected_animals ~
        "Direct contact with infected animal discharge",

      # Human transmission
      hum_Mosquito_bites ~
        "Mosquito bites",

      hum_Contact_with_blood_or_body_fluids_of_infected_animals ~
        "Contact with blood/body fluids of infected animals",

      hum_Eating_uncooked_or_undercooked_meat_from_infected_animals ~
        "Eating undercooked meat from infected animals",

      `hum_Touching_aborted_animal_fetus/Assisting_animal_in_giving_birth` ~
        "Touching aborted fetus/assisting birth",

      hum_Drinking_raw_milk_from_infected_animals ~
        "Drinking raw milk from infected animals"
    ),

    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",

    digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1),

    missing = "no"
  ) %>%

  # Keep only YES rows
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      filter(row_type != "level" | label == "1") %>%
      mutate(
        label = ifelse(label == "1", "", label)
      )
  ) %>%

  # Styling
  bold_labels() %>%
  italicize_levels() %>%

  modify_header(
    label ~ "**Route of Transmission**",
    stat_0 ~ "**n (%)**"
  ) %>%

  modify_caption(
    "**Table 3. Knowledge of Rift Valley Fever Transmission Routes (N = {N})**"
  )

table3
```

```{r, table 4 knowledge category}
# 6. Knowledge categorization 

df3 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    knowledge_level = case_when(
      total_knowledge_pct < 50 ~ "Poor",
      total_knowledge_pct < 75 ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ "Good"

kap_table <- df3 %>%
  select(
    knowledge_level

  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ± {sd}",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"

    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1,
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Knowledge Indicators**") %>%
  modify_caption(
    "**Table 4: Rift Valley Fever Knowledge Scores Among Respondents**"

kap_table
```
